newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Airlines enjoys new surge in business.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Airlines enjoys new surge in business.

text.p: Vietnam Airlines has enjoyed a new burst of growth in business this year, with passenger numbers and cargo volume hitting new records, official media reports said on Tuesday.
The Vietnam News Agency said that in the first nine months of this year, the state-owned flag carrier took more than 1.8 million passengers, a rise of 12 percent from the same period of 1995.
Cargo volume was 31,600 tonnes, up 37.8 percent.

Vietnam Airline's rise is perhaps the biggest success story of communist-run Vietnam's drive for reform along market lines. It is widely thought that when the country gets its first stock market, Vietnam Airlines will be one of the first listed.
Thanks to vigorous economic growth both at home and across Southeast Asia, the carrier saw its passenger load rise to 2.29 million last year from fewer than half a million in 1991.

Deputy director general Pham Ngoc Minh told Reuters earlier this year that the airline was expecting to carry some 2.8 million passengers and was looking for "controlled" growth of 20 to 23 percent a year between now and the end of the century.
